thread:
sam: FYI during the private-deploy smoke test the control-plane fell back to the in-cluster HSM shim for ~90s. Need an audit artifact and recommended RBAC tightenings.

neha: Do we know if the audit-forwarder dropped events or just buffered?

sam: Buffer hit ~650, buffer_write_errors=0, no drops. I grabbed a few log lines: `2026-05-14T09:02:11Z INFO routing: switched to hsm-shim:15001` and `2026-05-14T09:03:45Z INFO audit: enqueued 21 events`.

tim: Good. For compliance we need: signed audit bundle (with SHA256 manifest), rolebinding snapshot for hsm-shim SA, and list of key IDs used. Also we must prove no plaintext key material left the cluster.

priya: I can run `kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -n redwood-control -o yaml | grep -A2 hsm-shim` and export. The shim SA currently has a namespaced Role "hsm-shim-reader" and a ClusterRoleBinding to "kms-proxy-dns" only. No escalations.

neha: Mitigation: don't widen egress. Instead apply a narrow netpol that forces control-plane to talk to shim svc (15001) only. Example snippet I used earlier: `NetworkPolicy allow egress to podSelector app=hsm-shim port 15001`.

sam: I'll assemble the bundle: drain forwarder spool -> tar, generate SHA256 manifest, then gpg --detach-sign. I'll redact nonces but keep key refs (hk-2b9).

tim: Also run vuln-scan on the shim image (sha256) and include SBOM and scanner output in the bundle. If any high CVEs found, quarantine the image and block the sha in the registry.

priya: Compliance also requested an attestation from the KMS vendor that no rewrap/export calls occurred during the window. Can someone ping vendor ops?

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-SEC-5110: "shim fallback audit bundle + RBAC/netpol follow-ups" assigned to @sam and @neha. ETA 36h.

neha: Postmortem items: alert if forwarder buffer > 300, require SBOM + vuln check on any shim images, add e2e private-deploy canary verifying control-plane egress to shim. I'll open PRs for the alert and the netpol.

sam: Bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/2026-05-14/5110 with manifest, rolebindings, key ids, SBOM hash and signed bundle. Closing this thread; monitoring for reoccurrence. :thumbsup:
